technical_analysis.core_lesson: OLTP prioritizes low‑latency, ACID‑compliant row‑store operations; OLAP prioritizes high‑throughput, column‑store analytics with denormalized schemas
technical_analysis.common_misconception: Assuming OLTP can handle analytical workloads without redesign
technical_analysis.practical_takeaway: Use CDC to stream changes from OLTP to OLAP, but design separate schemas and storage formats to match each system’s performance goals
technical_analysis.useful_comparison: Row‑store, ACID, high concurrency vs Column‑store, high compression, batch analytics
